problem: Receptionists spend hours on manual document filing and phone booking in GP clinics.
business_model: B2B SaaS for clinics (pricing not found)

founders.name: Melvin Chen
education: University of Oxford, engineering triple major in Materials, Economics and Management
founders.background_notes: Source: YC page; Forbes 30 Under 30 Finance and VC per YC bio.

competitors.name: Heidi Health
competitors.what: AI scribe for clinicians in Australia, moving toward care agents
competitors.traction_then: Claims large GP share, its own claim

competitors.name: Lyrebird Health
competitors.what: AI scribe tied to Best Practice software

technical_complexity.rationale: Document extraction and voice agents integrated with practice management software; integration is the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Integration with clinic software gives some lock in, but scribe players are expanding into agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Heidi announced GP agent plans and a licensing dispute with Best Practice emerged in 2026.

market_need_then: Founder interviewed over 150 providers after moving to Australia in 2024 and found admin paperwork was the bottleneck; Samantha reportedly grew 175 percent month on month for five months to 150 clinics (company claim).

identity.voice_and_tone: Productivity of admin teams up 10x, plain operational language

branding.brand_signature: Human named agents such as Samantha and Veronica

brand_strength.rationale: A podcast and a Startmate profile cover it, but little press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Care GP started in Australia in 2024, went into Startmate on traction, claimed profitability and 150 plus clinics by October 2025, and entered YC in the Winter 2027 listing. Outcome not yet known; main risk is AI scribe leaders and software vendors moving into clinic admin agents.
notes: Seed announced 2026-06 per Seedtable; amounts conflict (500K on FundUp, 125K on Dealroom), unverified, so not recorded as a round. Startmate admission confirmed by its own article.
